prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Sugar Land, Texas, and has whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1095; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: This recorded statement is regarding a collision at an intersection in Sugar Land, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd prefer to keep my name off the recording for now, if that's alright. You can note that I was the driver of the vehicle.

Q: That works. Can you describe how the collision happened?

A: I was driving through the intersection on a green light. Another vehicle came from my right side and went through the red light. It struck the passenger side of my car, which is the side facing that direction.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: Only for a second. I saw movement from the right, but there wasn't enough time to react or brake.

Q: Were you injured?

A: Yes. My neck snapped forward and back when the impact happened. The next morning I had stiffness and pain that ran into my shoulders, and turning my head to check mirrors is hard now.

Q: Have you seen a medical provider since the collision?

A: I went to an urgent care clinic that same day and was told it looked like whiplash. I've been doing physical therapy twice a week since then.

Q: Were any police or emergency personnel at the scene?

A: An officer came out and took a report. I can give you the report number once I find it.

Q: Is there anything else you would like to add?

A: Only that I'm still having headaches and I've had to miss some shifts at work because of the pain. I'm willing to provide my medical records and any documentation you need.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.

A: Thank you.
